skill.name: R
skill.description: Avoid common R mistakes — vectorization traps, NA propagation, factor surprises, and indexing gotchas.
skill.summary: Vectorization - Loops are slow — use `apply()`, `lapply()`, `sapply()`, or `purrr::map()` - Vectorized functions operate on whole vectors — `sum(x)` not `for (i in x) total <- total + i` - `ifelse()` is vectorized — `if`
